# STUFF'D Bagels

> Cape Town's first stuffed bagel. Halal menu. Korean street-food style stuffed bagels, handmade and sold from our cart at markets and festivals across Cape Town. Pre-order on the website and collect at our stall on market day (12pm to 5pm), collect on a Saturday at one of our pickup points when they are open, or just buy at the cart. Online orders are confirmed once paid.

Slogan: "Every bite packed right." Cape Town, South Africa. Est. 2026. Street food, pop-up, handmade. No tables, no reservations. More markets, more bagels.

## Menu (ZAR)
The whole menu is halal.
- Classic Bagel: R65 (cream cheese)
- Jalapeno Bagel: R75 (jalapeno cream cheese, jalapenos)
- Cheesy Bagel: R85 (cream cheese, cheese)
- Pizza Bagel: R95 (pepperoni, cream cheese, cheese)
- Steak'd Bagel: R115 (birria (halal beef), cream cheese, cheese)

## How ordering works
- Pick your bagels on the website, fill in your details and pay on Yoco's secure page. Once it is paid the order goes to the kitchen and you get a confirmation email.
- An order is confirmed once it is paid on Yoco's secure page; we then email you the confirmation.
- Markets: pre-order online and collect at our stall on market day, 12pm to 5pm. Pre-orders close on the Wednesday before the market. Or skip pre-ordering and buy at the cart.
- Saturday pickup points: when they are open, order by Wednesday and collect on that Saturday.
- Cancel before the Wednesday cut-off with the link in your confirmation email for a full refund to your card. After the cut-off, or if you don't collect, the order becomes credit (valid 6 months).
- We email a reminder on the morning of your collection day.
- Private events: use the event form on the website for a custom quote.
